thread:
maria: Quick canary run with zephyrv2-int4 on onboarding batch A. Noticing funcall parse failures ~3.8% vs 0.4% baseline. Most failures are trailing-comma or newline-escape in tool args. attaching sample.
ajay: ugh. can you paste the failing output? do we have an example? 
maria: ```
Assistant: {
  "action": "search",
  "args": {"query": "foo,bar",}
}
``` 
sam: yep trailing comma. do we see this only in int4 or also int8? 
maria: int8 mirror shows 0.6% — so quantization seems to amplify. int4 batch looks noisier near token boundaries. 
lee: did KV cache/batching change for this run? batching was 32->48 for canary? 
maria: mirror config: batching 40, kv_prefix enabled, max_seq 1024. baseline had batching 32. 
ajay: could be tokenization drift with kv_prefix merging. try schema-lint pass server-side before parse + a small retry with lenient parser. 
sam: what's retry budget? we gave canary 2 retries per request. maybe increase to 3 for int4. 
maria: increased to 3 for the last 2 hours; failures dropped to 2.1% but still > baseline. 
infra-bot: deploy-log: canary/int4 rolled config schema-lint enabled at 1733333400 by ajay. 
lee: can we run a quick sample that wraps toolcall in JSON.parse tolerant wrapper? e.g., run `jsonrepair` on suffixes. 
ajay: yes we'll add a postprocess step: try `jsonrepair` heuristic then fall back to strict reject. 
sam: we should collect examples for an eval: 500 int4 failures and 500 baseline to run a repair/accept metric. 
maria: started collection -> saved to s3://redwood-canary/1733333333-fail-samples.json (partial). 
ajay: assign: ajay will implement server lint + repair; sam will build eval harness; lee will look at kv/batch interplay. 
maria: timeline: aim for reduced false rejects <0.7% before rolling int4 wider. 
sam: noted. Also add a regression alert on parse-failure-rate > 1% on canary. 
lee: will instrument a span so we can see token boundary where error originates. 
ajay: quick note — if repair pipeline increases end-to-end latency >30ms we need to throttle. 
maria: agree. will monitor p95. 
sam: thanks team. ping me when 500 samples ready. :thumbsup:
